all_maybe_eq_summary.sql: SELECT r.benchmark,count(*) AS n,group_concat(DISTINCT p.neq_reason_unknown) AS reasons FROM _run_ r JOIN iteration i ON i.run_id=r.run_id JOIN partition p ON p.iteration_id=i.id WHERE r.tool='PASDA-diff' AND p.result='MAYBE_EQ' GROUP BY r.benchmark

selected_runs.sql: SELECT r.benchmark,r.run_timeout,r.run_id,r.run,r.result_iteration,r.result,s.solver_timeout FROM _run_ r JOIN settings s ON s.run_id=r.run_id WHERE r.run_id IN (17472,30384,17432)

other_tables.sql: SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND (lower(name) LIKE '%path%' OR lower(name) LIKE '%symbol%' OR lower(name) LIKE '%output%' OR lower(name) LIKE '%effect%')

maybe_source_coverage.sql: SELECT pi.partition_id,pi.version,ins.source_file,group_concat(DISTINCT ins.source_line) AS lines FROM partition_instruction pi JOIN instruction ins ON ins.id=pi.instruction_id WHERE pi.partition_id IN (153200,658810,152310) GROUP BY pi.partition_id,pi.version,ins.source_file

selected_cohort_300.sql:
WITH ranked AS (
 SELECT r.*, row_number() OVER (
 PARTITION BY benchmark,run_timeout,depth_limit ORDER BY run_id) AS ordinal
 FROM _run_ r WHERE tool='PASDA-diff'
), selected AS (SELECT * FROM ranked WHERE ordinal=1),
 data AS (SELECT r.benchmark,r.run_timeout,r.run_id,r.result AS program_result,
 i.iteration,p.* FROM selected r
 JOIN iteration i ON i.run_id=r.run_id AND i.iteration=r.result_iteration
 JOIN partition p ON p.iteration_id=i.id WHERE p.result IS NOT NULL)
SELECT count(*) AS runs,count(DISTINCT benchmark) AS benchmarks,min(run_id) AS min_run_id,max(run_id) AS max_run_id FROM selected WHERE run_timeout=300

maybe_eq_by_timeout_all_iterations.sql: SELECT r.run_timeout,count(*) AS n,count(DISTINCT r.run_id) AS runs,group_concat(DISTINCT r.benchmark) AS benchmarks FROM _run_ r JOIN iteration i ON i.run_id=r.run_id JOIN partition p ON p.iteration_id=i.id WHERE r.tool='PASDA-diff' AND p.result='MAYBE_EQ' GROUP BY r.run_timeout
